patch_description: Introduce a lightweight data re-upload between the two repeats within each upload. After applying the first ansatz block for an upload, we re-apply the feature map (data encoding) before the second repeat. This implements an explicit data re-upload (l=3 style) between repeats to improve gradient flow and potentially boost training stability and validation/test performance without changing the total number of blocks or depth.
